big_case.notes: Local, fact-bound takings dispute: one landowner, a barrier fence on vacant lots in Catoosa, Oklahoma, a rescinded cease-and-desist order, an unpublished Tenth Circuit order affirming on limitations/savings-statute grounds, no claimed split, respondent waived, denied without writing at the long conference. The only broader hook (how state-court exhaustion or mootness dismissals interact with post-Knick federal takings suits) is not cleanly presented. Formed from the record and outcome; the predictors' big_case_score values were unavoidably visible in the staged prediction.json before this note was written.
